sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their excellent run of form. Sandbach are on a five-game winning streak and sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, while Alsager arrive in poor form with just one win in their last six outings and sit bottom of the division with only 4 points.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach, as Stafford are unbeaten in their last three with two wins. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a match between two strong sides—Bridgnorth have won five of their last six despite a recent loss, while Eccleshall are currently on a two-game losing run after a strong mid-season period. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community in a clash of mid-table sides, with the Casuals having won their last outing and looking solid in fifth place. Bilston Town visit Foley Meir in a duel between two consistent performers in the upper half, both showing decent recent form. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a battle at the lower end of the table, with both sides struggling for consistency. In-form Barnton travel to Shawbury United, who are enduring a difficult run of five consecutive defeats. New Mills visit Market Drayton Town as both search for momentum—Market Drayton have won three of their last four while New Mills are winless in their last two. Cheadle Heath Nomads face Telford Town in a clash between the two poorest-performing sides in the division, both on extended losing streaks. Finally, Brereton Social host Widnes Town, with the visitors pointless at the bottom of the league while Brereton sit in the lower half looking to push higher.
